description: Evidence-backed research, comparison, license verification, and stack planning for open-source AI projects; live project evidence requires the separately configured read-only MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-backed open-source AI research and selection
interface.longDescription: Research and evaluate open-source AI projects using evidence-backed workflows. Find projects from deployment and technical requirements, structure named-project verification, compare alternatives, and design candidate AI stacks while keeping verified facts, recommendations, unknowns, and risks explicitly separated. Live project evidence requires the separately configured read-only MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Find a self-hosted RAG platform with Docker and a Web UI. Keep hard requirements separate from preferences.
Compare Dify and RAGFlow for an enterprise knowledge-base use case, clearly separating verified facts from assumptions and unknowns.
Check what evidence I need before relying on an open-source AI project's license for commercial adoption.
Find alternatives to an open-source AI project while preserving my deployment constraints.
Design a self-hosted open-source AI stack for internal document question answering and mark every unverified compatibility or license condition.
